topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture aims and outlines the core framework of cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and investigate how the differentiation state of the initiating cell shapes malignant potential across different tissues.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Inflammation and Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external environmental exposures and chronic inflammatory signaling act as essential promotional cues to permit the malignant outgrowth of mutated cells.

topics.label: Established Tumor Stroma and Spatial Profiling Technologies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the continuous dependency of established tumors on supportive microenvironments and the modern high-resolution profiling methods used to investigate them.

topics.label: Integrated Framework of Cancer Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's concepts by uniting genetic alterations, cellular hierarchies, and microenvironmental pressures into an overarching evolutionary model.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
